verdict.rationale: E2B is explicitly positioned as isolated cloud sandboxes for running AI-generated code, with docs on running code/commands, filesystem access, network control, timeouts/kill switches, and resource limits — all designed to isolate execution from the developer's own infrastructure. Community evidence corroborates real usage as an agent code-execution backend, though it notes some workflow friction unrelated to isolation safety itself. Missing for 10: independent third-party security audit or pentest report confirming sandbox escape resistance.
